item.title: RIVERMAN’S VISTA: Why a constitutionally enacted People’s Transition Council is good for Mindanao
item.description: QUEZON CITY (MindaNews / 03 December) — Let me begin with a clear principle. I oppose any military junta, any civilian power grab, and any unconstitutional attempt to change our political system. The Philippines must never return to authoritarian shortcuts or extralegal transitions. The only acceptable path is a constitutional, civilian-led, democratic, and participatory process. […]
